items.text: Malik Nabers active after true game-time decision; family skipped game as he was unsure until ~2 hours pre-kickoff. Played and returned from ACL.
items.why: Self-decision after full practices; felt ready late.
items.implication: Start post-activation despite decoy risk; WR1 usage.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as Cardinals wouldn't activate if overly worried about ankle. Confirmed expected by ETR pregame.
items.why: Team made him active; ankle not limiting enough to sit.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside in debut role.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries expected if healthy enough to dress.

items.text: Alvin Kamara not expected and confirmed inactive (knee/MCL); Saints easing him back despite full Friday practice. Affects Etienne projection upward.
items.why: Caution after MCL sprain; another week of practice preferred.
items.opportunity: Zero; full backfield to Etienne + Miller.

items.text: Zay Flowers left early with hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI upcoming, would have returned in playoff scenario.
Postgame injury watch: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), others. Kamara absence boosted Etienne.
Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT with wrist injury (fracture, several weeks).
items.opportunity: None near-term; Ravens WR depth opens.

items.text: A.J. Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed, sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed, conservative timeline.
items.implication: IR/stash; NE WR depth rises short-term.

items.text: Rome Odunze officially active (calf); ETR had him expected to play.
Brock Bowers (meniscus trim) realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2; walking unaided postgame.
items.why: Minor procedure; team optimistic short absence.
items.implication: Hold; TE1 soon. Mayer short-term fill.

items.text: Slot stay-on rates in 2-WR: Josh Downs yes (32/34 routes), Jayden Reed no (29/46), Luther Burden somewhat (27/38).
items.opportunity: Downs high route share; others situational.

items.text: Jonathan Taylor dominated even in loss: 89% snaps, 59% routes, 96% RB opportunities, 13% target share. Colts don't trust backups.
items.why: Historical loss struggles irrelevant; no committee trust.
items.implication: Lock RB1 every week; volume floor elite.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 production signals larger role.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason belief in Bears offense volume unchanged despite Week 1 weirdness.
items.why: Wants Bears offense exposure; targets will come.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not; preseason talk with new OC Mannion validated by usage.
items.implication: Roster/start as PHI WR depth piece.
